english: I used to go to sleep hugging my terrarium, but I kept getting ants in my bed...
french: Avant, je m'endormais en serrant fort mon terrarium, mais je me retrouvais toujours avec des fourmis dans mon lit...
russian: Раньше я засыпал, обняв террариум, но потом у меня в постели стали появляться муравьи...
bulgarian: I used to go to sleep hugging my terrarium, but I kept getting ants in my bed...

english: Oh, hello! Greetings!
french: Oh, salut ! Ça va ?
russian: Ой, привет!
bulgarian: Oh, hello! Greetings!

english: She doesn't believe me when I tell her I'm nocturnal!
french: Elle ne me croit pas quand je lui dis que je suis un animal nocturne !
russian: Она не верит, когда я говорю, что я ночной житель!
bulgarian: She doesn't believe me when I tell her I'm nocturnal!

english: Mama says we have to go to bed.
french: Maman dit qu'il est l'heure d'aller au lit.
russian: Мама говорит, пора ложиться спать.
bulgarian: Mama says we have to go to bed.

english: Some people count sheep to fall asleep, but I like to count beetles.
french: Certains comptent les moutons pour s'endormir. Moi, je préfère compter les scarabées.
russian: Некоторые считают овец, чтобы уснуть, а я считаю жуков.
bulgarian: Some people count sheep to fall asleep, but I like to count beetles.

english: It sure would be neat if the Dragonguard could all ride big ants!
french: Ça serait génial que les membres de la Garde des dragons chevauchent des fourmis géantes !
russian: Было бы круто, если бы вся Драконья стража ездила на муравьях!
bulgarian: It sure would be neat if the Dragonguard could all ride big ants!

english: I had a dream I was riding a big ant, like a horse.
french: J'ai rêvé que je montais sur le dos d'une fourmi géante, comme si c'était un cheval.
russian: Мне приснилось, что я скачу верхом на большом муравье, как на лошади.
bulgarian: I had a dream I was riding a big ant, like a horse.

english: I wonder what's the biggest bug that ever lived in Mistria...
french: Je me demande quel est le plus grand insecte qui ait vécu à Mistria...
russian: Интересно, какое самое большое насекомое жило в Мистрии...
bulgarian: I wonder what's the biggest bug that ever lived in Mistria...

english: Did you know a caterpillar can survive on only one large leaf a day? Amazing.
french: Tu savais qu'une chenille pouvait survivre en ne mangeant qu'une grande feuille par jour ? Incroyable.
russian: Знаешь, гусенице хватает одного большого листа в день, чтобы жить! Удивительно.
bulgarian: Did you know a caterpillar can survive on only one large leaf a day? Amazing.

english: Sometimes, at night, I twirl up my sheets and pretend I'm in a cocoon!
french: Parfois, le soir, je m'enroule dans mes draps et je fais comme si j'étais dans un cocon !
russian: Иногда ночью я заворачиваюсь в одеяло и притворяюсь, что я в коконе!
bulgarian: Sometimes, at night, I twirl up my sheets and pretend I'm in a cocoon!

english: Good night, [Ari]. Be sure to wake me up if you see a cool bug.
french: Bonne nuit, [Ari]. Réveille-moi si tu trouves un drôle d'insecte.
russian: Спокойной ночи, [Ari]. Разбуди меня, если увидишь классного жука.
bulgarian: Good night, [Ari]. Be sure to wake me up if you see a cool bug.

english: Bella the orchid mantis likes when Papa plays the lute. She kind of sways around...
french: Bella, notre mante orchidée, aime bien quand papa joue du luth. Elle se balance en rythme...
russian: Орхидейная богомолица Белла любит, когда папа играет на лютне. Она так мило качается...
bulgarian: Bella the orchid mantis likes when Papa plays the lute. She kind of sways around...

english: She's cool and strong, but most importantly she listens to me talk about bugs.
french: Elle est forte et courageuse, et surtout, elle m'écoute quand je lui parle d'insectes.
russian: Она классная и сильная, но самое главное — слушает, когда я говорю про жуков.
bulgarian: She's cool and strong, but most importantly she listens to me talk about bugs.

english: Dell's our leader!
french: C'est Dell, la cheffe !
russian: Делл — наша главная!
bulgarian: Dell's our leader!

english: There is a non-zero probability that Dell will jump in that fountain.
french: D'après mes calculs, les probabilités que Dell ne saute pas dans cette fontaine sont quasi nulles.
russian: Существует ненулевая вероятность, что Делл прыгнет в фонтан.
bulgarian: There is a non-zero probability that Dell will jump in that fountain.

english: Dinner is very important! That's what Doctor Valen told me!
french: Le dîner est un repas très important ! C'est la docteure Valen qui me l'a dit !
russian: Ужин — это очень важно! Так сказала докторша Вален!
bulgarian: Dinner is very important! That's what Doctor Valen told me!

english: Mr. Errol says insects used to be REALLY ginormous in the past. I wanna see!
french: D'après monsieur Errol, les insectes étaient gigantesques, avant. J'aurais trop voulu voir ça !
russian: Мистер Эррол говорит, что раньше насекомые были ОЧЕНЬ гигантскими. Хочу увидеть!
bulgarian: Mr. Errol says insects used to be REALLY ginormous in the past. I wanna see!

english: It takes me a while to go to sleep because I have to say good night to all my bugs, going in alphabetical order by genus.
french: Je ne vais pas me coucher de bonne heure parce que je souhaite bonne nuit à chacun de mes insectes, dans l'ordre alphabétique de leur taxon.
russian: Я долго засыпаю, потому что говорю «спокойной ночи» всем своим жукам в алфавитном порядке по родам.
bulgarian: It takes me a while to go to sleep because I have to say good night to all my bugs, going in alphabetical order by genus.

english: [Ari], [Ari]! How'd you get so good at catching bugs?
french: [Ari], [Ari] ! Comment tu es devenu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> aussi doué<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> pour attraper des insectes ?
russian: [Ari], [Ari]! Как ты так хорошо ловишь жуков?
bulgarian: [Ari], [Ari]! How'd you get so good at catching bugs?

english: Wow, [Ari]! You're like a legendary bugcatcher!
french: Waouh, [Ari] ! Tu es vraiment devenu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> une légende de l'entomologie !
russian: Ух ты, [Ari]! Ты прямо легендарный ловец насекомых!
bulgarian: Wow, [Ari]! You're like a legendary bugcatcher!

english: Excellent. My name's Luc! I'm so excited to have a fellow insect enthusiast in town. Finally!
french: Génial ! Moi, c'est Luc. Je suis trop content qu'il y ait enfin quelqu'un d'autre qui aime les insectes dans cette ville !
russian: Отлично. Меня зовут Люк! Так здорово, что в городе появился ещё один энтомолог-энтузиаст. Наконец-то!
bulgarian: Excellent. My name's Luc! I'm so excited to have a fellow insect enthusiast in town. Finally!

english: Wait until I tell my sisters!
french: Quand je vais dire ça à mes sœurs !
russian: Вот только расскажу об этом сёстрам!
bulgarian: Wait until I tell my sisters!

english: You know, insects? My name's Luc and I'm a junior member of The Royal Society of Entomology.
french: Oui, les petites bestioles ! Moi, c'est Luc. Je suis un cadet de la Société royale d'entomologie.
russian: Ну, насекомые, жуки. Меня зовут Люк, и я младший участник Королевского энтомологического общества.
bulgarian: You know, insects? My name's Luc and I'm a junior member of The Royal Society of Entomology.

english: I get a birthday card from them every year in recognition of my work. If you join, maybe you will too!
french: Tous les ans, ils m'envoient une carte d'anniversaire en reconnaissance de mon travail. Si tu t'inscris, tu y auras peut-être droit, toi aussi !
russian: Они присылают мне открытку на день рождения в знак признания моих заслуг. Если вступишь, может, и тебе пришлют!
bulgarian: I get a birthday card from them every year in recognition of my work. If you join, maybe you will too!

english: Hello! Do you like bugs?
french: Bonjour ! Tu aimes les insectes ?
russian: Привет! Тебе нравятся насекомые?
bulgarian: Hello! Do you like bugs?

english: Y...yes?
french: Euh... oui ?
russian: Ээ... да?
bulgarian: Y...yes?

english: What?
french: Pardon ?
russian: Что?
bulgarian: What?

english: Mister Hayden sure is nice... I like him.
french: Monsieur Hayden est vraiment gentil... Je l'aime beaucoup.
russian: Мистер Хейден такой добрый... он мне нравится.
bulgarian: Mister Hayden sure is nice... I like him.

english: I'm hungry, and sleepy... like a sleepy, hungry caterpillar...
french: J'ai faim et j'ai sommeil... Comme une chenille qui aurait faim et sommeil...
russian: Я голодный и сонный... как гусеница, которая хочет спать и есть...
bulgarian: I'm hungry, and sleepy... like a sleepy, hungry caterpillar...

english: If you see one you gotta let me know, okay?
french: Si tu en aperçois un, préviens-moi, d'accord ?
russian: Если увидишь какого-нибудь — обязательно скажи мне, ладно?
bulgarian: If you see one you gotta let me know, okay?

english: Do you like bugs, [Ari]? I think they're pretty neat.
french: Tu aimes les insectes, [Ari] ? Moi, je les trouve vraiment fascinants.
russian: Тебе нравятся жуки, [Ari]? По-моему, они крутые.
bulgarian: Do you like bugs, [Ari]? I think they're pretty neat.

english: The Dragonguard spy network is all the insects I've trained to bring me information. It's, um... still a work in progress.
french: Le réseau d'espions de la Garde des dragons est composé de tous les insectes que j'ai dressés. Il y a... Il y a encore quelques détails à mettre au point.
russian: Шпионская сеть Драконьей стражи — это все насекомые, которых я дрессирую приносить мне новости. Ну... она пока в разработке.
bulgarian: The Dragonguard spy network is all the insects I've trained to bring me information. It's, um... still a work in progress.

english: Dell says we'll explore there, when we're older. That's good, I'll be less scared by then.
french: Dell m'a dit qu'on irait les explorer quand on sera plus grands. Tant mieux, j'aurai sûrement moins peur d'ici là.
russian: Делл сказала, что мы пойдём туда, когда станем старше. Это хорошо: я меньше буду бояться.
bulgarian: Dell says we'll explore there, when we're older. That's good, I'll be less scared by then.

english: I wonder what kind of insects are in the Mines!
french: Je me demande quels types d'insectes on trouve dans les mines.
russian: Интересно, какие насекомые живут в шахтах!
bulgarian: I wonder what kind of insects are in the Mines!

english: I wonder how Arthur keeps getting out... I should record this in my Tarantula File.
french: Je me demande comment Arthur arrive toujours à s'échapper... Je devrais consigner tout ça dans mon dossier Tarentules.
russian: Как Артуру удается снова и снова сбегать из террариума? Надо записать это в заметки по тарантулам.
bulgarian: I wonder how Arthur keeps getting out... I should record this in my Tarantula File.

english: I don't get it, but I'll do it for the kingdom!
french: Je ne comprends pas tout, mais je le ferai pour le bien du royaume !
russian: Я не понял, но сделаю ради королевства!
bulgarian: I don't get it, but I'll do it for the kingdom!

english: Queen Maple says she's marrying me off to a princess I've never met for political reasons, and if I'm lucky it might grow into love.
french: La reine Maple veut me marier à une princesse que je ne connais pas pour sceller des alliances. Elle dit qu'avec un peu de chance, j'en tomberai amoureux.
russian: Королева Мэйпл говорит, что по политическим причинам решила выдать меня за принцессу, которую я никогда не видел. И если повезёт, я её полюблю.
bulgarian: Queen Maple says she's marrying me off to a princess I've never met for political reasons, and if I'm lucky it might grow into love.

english: Mama keeps kicking Daddy under the table... I wonder if he's in trouble.
french: Maman donne souvent des coups de pied à papa, sous la table... Il a fait quelque chose de mal ?
russian: Мама всё время пинает папу под столом... Интересно, он что, провинился?
bulgarian: Mama keeps kicking Daddy under the table... I wonder if he's in trouble.

english: Morning, [Ari]! I'm thinking about what bugs the day will bring...
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Je pense aux insectes que je vais trouver aujourd'hui...
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]! Думаю, какие жуки сегодня попадутся...
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! I'm thinking about what bugs the day will bring...

english: Most people think monarch butterfly, but I like sternocera aequisignata- the jewel beetle- way more.
french: Les gens pensent souvent au papillon monarque, mais pour moi, ce serait plutôt le sternocera aequisignata, ou scarabée moiré.
russian: Многие говорят, что монарх, но мне больше нравится sternocera aequisignata — жук-драгоценность!
bulgarian: Most people think monarch butterfly, but I like sternocera aequisignata- the jewel beetle- way more.

english: Maple asked me which bug is the most royal.
french: Maple me demandait quel insecte avait le plus l'air royal.
russian: Мэйпл спросила, кто самый королевский из насекомых.
bulgarian: Maple asked me which bug is the most royal.

english: Mom packed us lots of snacks, [Ari]! Here, you can have some.
french: [Ari], maman nous a préparé plein de choses pour le goûter ! Tiens, goûte ça.
russian: Мама собрала много перекусов, [Ari]! Вот, держи немного.
bulgarian: Mom packed us lots of snacks, [Ari]! Here, you can have some.

english: Maybe she went to the kitchen for a snack?
french: Elle est peut-être allée à la cuisine pour manger un bout ?
russian: Может, пошла на кухню перекусить?
bulgarian: Maybe she went to the kitchen for a snack?

english: Hi [Ari]. I'm supposed to be sleeping, but Bella the orchid mantis got out.
french: Salut, [Ari]. Je devrais être au lit, mais Bella, ma mante orchidée, s'est échappée.
russian: Привет, [Ari]. Я должен спать, но орхидейная богомолица Белла сбежала.
bulgarian: Hi [Ari]. I'm supposed to be sleeping, but Bella the orchid mantis got out.

english: I'm teaching Maple about the worker bees of apis mellifera, but she only cares about the queen bee.
french: J'enseigne à Maple l'importance des abeilles ouvrières de la famille des apis mellifera, mais tout ce qui l'intéresse, c'est la reine.
russian: Я учу Мэйпл рабочим пчёлам apis mellifera, но ей интересна только королева.
bulgarian: I'm teaching Maple about the worker bees of apis mellifera, but she only cares about the queen bee.

english: Please act accordingly, [Ari].
french: [Ari], tiens-toi bien.
russian: Прошу соблюдать протокол, [Ari].
bulgarian: Please act accordingly, [Ari].

english: I promised Maple we'd play royals today, so for the rest of today she's Queen Maple.
french: J'ai promis à Maple qu'on jouerait à la famille royale, aujourd'hui. Elle sera la reine Maple jusqu'à ce soir.
russian: Я пообещал Мэйпл, что сегодня играем в королевство, так что теперь она — королева Мэйпл.
bulgarian: I promised Maple we'd play royals today, so for the rest of today she's Queen Maple.

english: She's nice.
french: Elle est adorable.
russian: Она хорошая.
bulgarian: She's nice.

english: Rachelle woke me up today... she's a mantis religiosa, otherwise known as a praying mantis.
french: Rachelle m'a réveillé, aujourd'hui... C'est une mante religieuse, ou mantis religiosa.
russian: Сегодня меня разбудила Рашель... она mantis religiosa, по-другому — богомол обыкновенный.
bulgarian: Rachelle woke me up today... she's a mantis religiosa, otherwise known as a praying mantis.

english: Some insects prefer to come out on rainy days, [Ari].
french: Certains insectes préfèrent sortir quand il pleut, [Ari].
russian: Некоторым насекомым нравится выходить в дождь, [Ari].
bulgarian: Some insects prefer to come out on rainy days, [Ari].

english: Dell likes to hold our Dragonguard meetings on rainy days. That's when we make all our plans for protecting Mistria!
french: Dell tient à organiser les réunions de la Garde des dragons les jours de pluie. C'est là qu'on organise la protection de Mistria !
russian: Делл любит устраивать собрания Драконьей стражи в дождливые дни. Тогда мы строим планы по защите Мистрии!
bulgarian: Dell likes to hold our Dragonguard meetings on rainy days. That's when we make all our plans for protecting Mistria!

english: Ma and Pa are busy today, so I'm watching the register. I can make change, I'm good at math! Want to see?
french: Maman et papa sont occupés aujourd'hui, donc c'est moi qui tiens la caisse. Je sais rendre la monnaie et je suis bon en calcul. Tu veux que je te montre ?
russian: Ма и па сегодня заняты, так что я сижу за кассой. Я умею давать сдачу, я хорошо считаю! Хочешь проверить?
bulgarian: Ma and Pa are busy today, so I'm watching the register. I can make change, I'm good at math! Want to see?

english: I like helping out, but I sure wish I could see over the counter.
french: J'aime bien me rendre utile, mais j'aimerais être un plus grand que le comptoir.
russian: Мне нравится помогать, но жаль, что стойка такая высокая: ничего не видно.
bulgarian: I like helping out, but I sure wish I could see over the counter.

english: According to my calculations, today has seen a fifty percent boost in sales because I'm behind the counter.
french: Si mes calculs sont justes, les ventes ont augmenté de 50 % aujourd'hui, grâce à ma présence à la caisse.
russian: Согласно моим расчётам, сегодня продажи выросли на 50%, потому что я за кассой.
bulgarian: According to my calculations, today has seen a fifty percent boost in sales because I'm behind the counter.

english: I mean, um, The Sleeping Dragon Inn.
french: Enfin, à l'auberge du Dragon qui dort.
russian: То есть, эээ, в трактир «Спящий дракон».
bulgarian: I mean, um, The Sleeping Dragon Inn.

english: Hi [Ari]! Welcome to my house!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Ravi de te voir chez moi !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Добро пожаловать в мой дом!
bulgarian: Hi [Ari]! Welcome to my house!

english: Queen Maple says it's time to partake of our royal dinner. I hope that's the same as our normal dinner.
french: La reine Maple a décrété que c'était l'heure du souper royal. J'espère que c'est un peu comme nos repas à nous.
russian: Королева Мэйпл говорит, что пора отведать королевский ужин. Надеюсь, он как обычный.
bulgarian: Queen Maple says it's time to partake of our royal dinner. I hope that's the same as our normal dinner.

english: Have you seen any beehives around? Why? Uh... no reason...
french: Tu n'aurais pas vu une ruche, dans les parages ? Pourquoi ? Euh... Pour rien...
russian:
Ты нигде рядом не

видели

виделавиделвидело ульев? Зачем спрашиваю? Эм... просто так!
bulgarian: Have you seen any beehives around? Why? Uh... no reason...

english: Bees have a queen, but they can't have two, so one has to leave... and sometimes they fight it out for the crown!
french: Les abeilles ont une reine, pas deux. L'une d'elles doit donc partir. Parfois, elles se battent même pour la couronne !
russian: У пчёл бывает только одна королева, и если появляется вторая, одна должна уйти... иногда они даже дерутся за корону!
bulgarian: Bees have a queen, but they can't have two, so one has to leave... and sometimes they fight it out for the crown!

english: Miss Juniper will answer all the Dragonguard's questions about potions... I think.
french: Mademoiselle Juniper répondra à toutes les questions de la Garde des dragons à propos des potions... Enfin, j'espère.
russian: Мисс Джунипер ответит на все вопросы Драконьей стражи про зелья... наверное.
bulgarian: Miss Juniper will answer all the Dragonguard's questions about potions... I think.

english: Time to get all curled up in my honeycomb...
french: Il est temps d'aller me mettre au chaud dans ma ruche...
russian: Пора свернуться в клубочек в моей соте...
bulgarian: Time to get all curled up in my honeycomb...

english: Tall grass is a natural habitat for many insects.
french: Les hautes herbes sont l'habitat naturel de nombreuses espèces d'insectes.
russian: Высокая трава — это естественная среда для многих насекомых.
bulgarian: Tall grass is a natural habitat for many insects.

english: Vegetables are a good habitat too, I guess.
french: Tout comme les légumes, maintenant que j'y pense.
russian: Овощи тоже сгодятся как дом для жуков, я думаю.
bulgarian: Vegetables are a good habitat too, I guess.

english: Greetings, [Ari]! Have you cut the grass around your farm yet?
french: Salut [Ari] ! Tu as déjà coupé l'herbe qui pousse sur ta ferme ?
russian:
Приветствую, [Ari]! Ты уже

скосили

скосиласкосилскосило траву на своей ферме?
bulgarian: Greetings, [Ari]! Have you cut the grass around your farm yet?

english: Sometimes there's insects living underneath! I'd love to see what you find!
french: Il y a parfois des insectes qui vivent en dessous ! J'ai hâte de voir ce que tu trouveras !
russian: Иногда под ними прячутся насекомые! Очень хочу увидеть, кого ты найдёшь!
bulgarian: Sometimes there's insects living underneath! I'd love to see what you find!

english: [Ari]! Have you broken up the rocks around your farm?
french: [Ari] ! Tu as déjà brisé des pierres sur ton terrain ?
russian:
[Ari]! Ты

разломали

разломаларазломалразломало камни на ферме?
bulgarian: [Ari]! Have you broken up the rocks around your farm?

english: *sigh* Wish Dad would take us to the woods sometime. I bet I could find a beehive there.
french: *soupir* Si seulement papa nous emmenait parfois dans la forêt. Je suis sûr que je pourrais trouver une ruche, là-bas.
russian: Эх, вот бы папа сводил нас в лес. Там, наверное, улей можно найти.
bulgarian: *sigh* Wish Dad would take us to the woods sometime. I bet I could find a beehive there.

english: Thank you, [Ari]!
french: Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]!

english: Wow! A birthday present! For me!
french: Waouh ! Un cadeau d'anniversaire ? Pour moi ?
russian: Ух ты! Подарок на день рождения! Мне?!
bulgarian: Wow! A birthday present! For me!

english: Aw... I was hoping you were going to give me something interesting...
french: Oh... Je pensais que tu allais m'offrir un truc intéressant...
russian: Эх... Я надеялся на что-то поинтереснее...

bulgarian: A snack! Thanks [Ari], I'm gonna share this with the Dragonguard!

english: Wow, thanks [Ari]! You're a natural at bug-catching!
french: Waouh, merci, [Ari] ! Tu es <she>une</she><he>un</he><they>un·e</they> pro de la chasse aux insectes !

english: You're so cool, [Ari]! Thanks for sharing something this amazing with me!

russian: [Ari], вау! Какой редкий экземпляр! Это точно для меня? Надо срочно задокументировать!
bulgarian: [Ari], wow! What a rare specimen! Is this really for me? I have to document it right away!

english: Look at this rare beauty! You see the colors here? And the shape of the antennae? So cute!
french: C'est une beauté d'une grande rareté ! Ces couleurs ! Et la forme des antennes ! J'adore !
russian: Посмотри на эту редкую красоту! Видишь цвета? А форму усиков? Такая милота!
bulgarian: Look at this rare beauty! You see the colors here? And the shape of the antennae? So cute!

english: Whooooa, I love it! Look at those little legs! Thank you very much, [Ari]!

bulgarian: Whooooa, I love it! Look at those little legs! Thank you very much, [Ari]!

english: Thank you!
french: Merci !
russian: Спасибо!
bulgarian: Thank you!

english: Oh, for me? Let me think... yes, I think I can find room for it.
french: Oh, c'est pour moi ? Laisse-moi voir... Oui, je devrais pouvoir lui trouver une place.
russian: О, мне? Дай подумать... да, думаю, найду место.
bulgarian: Oh, for me? Let me think... yes, I think I can find room for it.

english: Darcy's so nice! She always gives me and Maple =Hot Chocolate=.
french: Darcy est trop gentille ! Elle nous offre toujours un =chocolat chaud= à Maple et moi.
russian: Дарси такая добрая! Она всегда угощает меня и Мэйпл =горячим шоколадом=.
bulgarian: Darcy's so nice! She always gives me and Maple =Hot Chocolate=.

english: Last time Dell got coffee, she got sooo hyper... she kept calling all my insects "tiny dragons", and then she said SHE was turning into a dragon... wow, [Ari]. Just wow.
french: Quand Dell boit un café, elle pète les plombs... La dernière fois, elle répétait que mes insectes étaient des « mini dragons » et qu'elle était dragon...
russian: В прошлый раз Делл выпила кофе и ТАК возбудилась... называла моих жуков «дракончиками», а потом сказала, что САМА станет драконом... ух, [Ari]. Просто ух.
bulgarian: Last time Dell got coffee, she got sooo hyper... she kept calling all my insects "tiny dragons", and then she said SHE was turning into a dragon... wow, [Ari]. Just wow.

english: Darcy's been making different flavors of hot chocolate... I really like the spicy one...
french: Darcy a plein de recettes de chocolat chaud. J'aime beaucoup celui aux épices...
russian: Дарси делает горячий шоколад с разными вкусами... мне очень нравится острый!
bulgarian: Darcy's been making different flavors of hot chocolate... I really like the spicy one...

english: In the winter, hot chocolate... in the summer, chocolate milk... Darcy is the best.
french: L'hiver, du chocolat chaud... L'été, du lait au chocolat... Darcy, c'est la meilleure.
russian: Зимой — горячий шоколад, летом — шоколадное молоко... Дарси — лучшая.
bulgarian: In the winter, hot chocolate... in the summer, chocolate milk... Darcy is the best.

english: Mister Louis promised me that he would make me a full beetle print suit for my debut at the Royal Society of Entymology! Now I REALLY have to get in...
french: Monsieur Louis a promis de me fabriquer un costume avec un imprimé scarabée si j'intègre la Société royale d'entomologie ! Du coup, je suis plus décidé que jamais...
russian: Мистер Луи пообещал сшить мне костюм с жуками для дебюта в Королевском энтомологическом обществе! Теперь мне ТОЧНО надо туда попасть...
bulgarian: Mister Louis promised me that he would make me a full beetle print suit for my debut at the Royal Society of Entymology! Now I REALLY have to get in...

english: Did you know that silk comes from the cocoons of domesticated silkworms? Amazing!
french: Tu savais que la soie venait des cocons de vers élevés par l'homme ? C'est fou !
russian: А ты знаешь, что шёлк делают из коконов одомашненных шелкопрядов? Удивительно!
bulgarian: Did you know that silk comes from the cocoons of domesticated silkworms? Amazing!

english: Mister Louis told me that some dyes are made from insect shells! Isn't that interesting?
french: Monsieur Louis m'a dit que certaines teintures étaient produites à partir de carapaces d'insectes ! Intéressant, non ?
russian: Мистер Луи сказал, что некоторые красители делают из панцирей насекомых! Разве не круто?
bulgarian: Mister Louis told me that some dyes are made from insect shells! Isn't that interesting?

english: Mister Louis says he'll consider insect prints for a future collection... I want a coat with a big praying mantis on the back.
french: Monsieur Louis réfléchit à l'utilisation d'imprimés insectes pour une prochaine collection... Je veux trop une veste avec une grosse mante religieuse dans le dos.
russian: Мистер Луи сказал, что подумает о принтах насекомых для следующей коллекции... я хочу плащ с большим богомолом на спине.
bulgarian: Mister Louis says he'll consider insect prints for a future collection... I want a coat with a big praying mantis on the back.

english: Miss Merri's booth always smells like wood and paint... it's not so bad, though.
french: Le stand de mademoiselle Merri sent toujours le bois et la peinture... Ce n'est pas désagréable.
russian: У мисс Мэрри в лавке всегда пахнет деревом и краской... но этот запах не такой уж плохой.
bulgarian: Miss Merri's booth always smells like wood and paint... it's not so bad, though.

english: I wonder if Miss Merri has a tiny dresser for sale... it's for my pet spider, of course. She has lots of socks.
french: Je me demande si mademoiselle Merri n'aurait pas une petite commode à vendre... C'est pour les chaussettes de mon araignée domestique.
russian: Интересно, есть ли у мисс Мэрри маленький комод на продажу... он нужен моей паучихе! У неё очень много носков.
bulgarian: I wonder if Miss Merri has a tiny dresser for sale... it's for my pet spider, of course. She has lots of socks.

english: I always check Miss Merri's booth for princessy furniture... Maple really wants it.
french: Je jette toujours un œil au stand de mademoiselle Merri pour voir si elle a des meubles de princesse... Maple adore ça.
russian: Я всегда заглядываю в лавку мисс Мэрри в поисках мебели в стиле принцесс... Мэйпл такое обожает.
bulgarian: I always check Miss Merri's booth for princessy furniture... Maple really wants it.

english: Don't tell Miss Merri, but I once kept my pet termites in one of her dressers and it went... bad. Actually, don't tell Ma either...
french: Ne le dis pas à mademoiselle Merri, mais une fois, j'ai laissé mes termites dans une de ses commodes et... ça a mal fini. Maman ne sait pas non plus...
russian: Не говори мисс Мэрри, но я как-то держал термитов в её комоде, и всё закончилось... плохо. И маме не говори, ладно?..
bulgarian: Don't tell Miss Merri, but I once kept my pet termites in one of her dressers and it went... bad. Actually, don't tell Ma either...

english: I asked Mister Stillwell for a fortune about my new mayfly, and he started crying... but fortune-telling isn't very scientific... right?
bulgarian: I asked Mister Stillwell for a fortune about my new mayfly, and he started crying... but fortune-telling isn't very scientific... right?

english: I got a love fortune for my praying mantis... it was bad, which is good... I don't want her to eat her mate.
bulgarian: I got a love fortune for my praying mantis... it was bad, which is good... I don't want her to eat her mate.

english: Whenever I ask Mister Stillwell for a life fortune for one of my insects, he starts blubbering and stuff... maybe I should stop asking...
bulgarian: Whenever I ask Mister Stillwell for a life fortune for one of my insects, he starts blubbering and stuff... maybe I should stop asking...

english: Maple always asks Mister Stillwell for a life fortune... she always manages to make them about becoming a princess.
bulgarian: Maple always asks Mister Stillwell for a life fortune... she always manages to make them about becoming a princess.

english: What does Mister Taliferro sell?
french: Mais monsieur Taliferro, qu'est-ce qu'il vend ?
russian: То что продаёт мистер Талиферро?
bulgarian: What does Mister Taliferro sell?

english: Because if it's bad manners, I can find those from Dell for free!
french: Parce que si c'est du manque de savoir-vivre, j'ai ça gratuitement avec Dell !
russian: Потому что, если это плохие манеры, то я могу взять бесплатно у Делл!
bulgarian: Because if it's bad manners, I can find those from Dell for free!

english: If Miss Merri sells furniture, and Mister Louis sells clothing, and Miss Darcy sells coffee...
french: Madame Merri vend des meubles, monsieur Louis vend des vêtements, madame Darcy vend du café...
russian: Если мисс Мэрри продаёт мебель, мистер Луи продаёт одежду, а мисс Дарси продаёт кофе...
bulgarian: If Miss Merri sells furniture, and Mister Louis sells clothing, and Miss Darcy sells coffee...

english: But that's okay! I gave her a flower and she seemed happy about it. She did a little dance and everything!
french: Ce n'est pas grave ! Je lui ai donné une fleur et elle avait l'air ravie. Elle a même fait une petite danse !
russian: Но это не страшно! Я дал ей цветочек, и она всё равно осталась довольна. Даже станцевала небольшой танец!
bulgarian: But that's okay! I gave her a flower and she seemed happy about it. She did a little dance and everything!

english: Mister Taliferro refused to make a dessert for my bee friend...
french: Monsieur Taliferro a refusé de préparer un dessert pour mon abeille...
russian: Мистер Талиферро отказался делать десерт для моей подружки-пчелы...
bulgarian: Mister Taliferro refused to make a dessert for my bee friend...

english: And anyway, she's already really good at preparing it for herself!
french: Et puis, elle sait très bien le faire toute seule !
russian: К тому же она сама отлично с этим справляется!
bulgarian: And anyway, she's already really good at preparing it for herself!

english: Mister Taliferro didn't want to make a mealworm souffle for my spider... I understand. I don't want to do it either.
french: Monsieur Taliferro n'a pas voulu préparer un soufflé aux asticots pour mon araignée... Je comprends. Moi non plus.
russian: Мистер Талиферро не захотел делать суфле из мучных червей для моей паучихи... Могу понять. Мне тоже не хочется.
bulgarian: Mister Taliferro didn't want to make a mealworm souffle for my spider... I understand. I don't want to do it either.

english: He's pretty and shiny, and yells a lot!
french: Il a beau avoir de l'allure, on n'entend que lui !
russian: Он красивый, блестящий и тоже громко кричит!
bulgarian: He's pretty and shiny, and yells a lot!

english: If Mister Taliferro was an insect... maybe he'd be a $Cicada$!
french: Si monsieur Taliferro était un insecte... ce serait une $cigale$ !
russian: Если бы мистер Талиферро был насекомым... наверное, он был бы $цикадой$!
bulgarian: If Mister Taliferro was an insect... maybe he'd be a $Cicada$!

english: I told Miss Vera that some dyes are made from insects! She said she doesn't use that kind, though.
french: J'ai dit à mademoiselle Vera que certaines teintures étaient faites à partir d'insectes ! Elle m'a assuré que pas chez elle.
russian: Я сказал мисс Вере, что красители делают из насекомых! Она сказала, что такими не пользуется.
bulgarian: I told Miss Vera that some dyes are made from insects! She said she doesn't use that kind, though.

english: Do you think bright hair would make bug catching easier?
french: Tu crois que j'attraperais plus d'insectes si je me teignais les cheveux ?
russian: Как думаешь, яркие волосы помогут мне в ловле жуков?
bulgarian: Do you think bright hair would make bug catching easier?

english: Some insects are attracted to bright colors...
french: Certains insectes sont attirés par les couleurs vives...
russian: Некоторых насекомых привлекают яркие цвета...
bulgarian: Some insects are attracted to bright colors...

english: I guess I might dye my hair if it made insects think I was a flower... it would be easier to see them up close, don't you think?
french: Je me teindrais sans hésiter les cheveux pour que les insectes me prennent pour une fleur... Comme ça, je pourrais les observer plus facilement de près !
russian: Может, если я покрашусь, жуки подумают, что я — цветок... тогда их было бы легче разглядывать, не думаешь?
bulgarian: I guess I might dye my hair if it made insects think I was a flower... it would be easier to see them up close, don't you think?

english: Some insects can see more colors than the human eye! I wonder if Vera can dye my hair a color only pollinators can see...
french: Certains insectes voient plus de couleurs que les humains ! Peut-être que Vera pourrait me teindre les cheveux d'une couleur uniquement visible par les pollinisateurs ?
russian: Некоторые насекомые видят больше цветов, чем человек! Интересно, может ли Вера покрасить волосы в цвет, который видят только опылители?..
bulgarian: Some insects can see more colors than the human eye! I wonder if Vera can dye my hair a color only pollinators can see...

english: But [Ari]! Snakes don't have hair!
french: [Ari], les serpents n'ont pas de poils !
russian: Но [Ari], у змей ведь нет волос!
bulgarian: But [Ari]! Snakes don't have hair!

english: I asked Mister Wheedle if he makes his $Snake Oil$ by extracting oil from snakes. He said he'd never hurt a hair on a snake's head.
french: J'ai demandé à monsieur Wheedle s'il faisait son $huile de couleuvre$ avec de vrais serpents. Il a dit qu'il ne toucherait pas à un poil de ces animaux.
russian: Я спросил у мистера Хлюста, получает ли он $змеиное масло$ из настоящих змей. Он сказал, что не тронет и волоска с головы змеи.
bulgarian: I asked Mister Wheedle if he makes his $Snake Oil$ by extracting oil from snakes. He said he'd never hurt a hair on a snake's head.

english: When I told him that beeswax is solid at room temperature, he changed the subject...
french: Quand je lui ai dit que la cire d'abeille était solide à température ambiante, il a changé de sujet...
russian: Когда я ему сказал, что пчелиный воск при комнатной температуре твёрдый, он перевёл тему...
bulgarian: When I told him that beeswax is solid at room temperature, he changed the subject...

english: Mister Wheedle tried to sell me something called Bee Oil!
french: Monsieur Wheedle a essayé de me vendre une soi-disant « huile d'abeille » !
russian: Мистер Хлюст хотел мне продать какое-то «пчелиное масло»!
bulgarian: Mister Wheedle tried to sell me something called Bee Oil!

english: Maybe she'd like him more if he learned how to make balloon animals?
french: Peut-être qu'elle l'apprécierait plus s'il savait faire des ballons en forme d'animaux ?
russian: Может, она бы относилась к нему лучше, если бы он научился делать зверей из шариков?
bulgarian: Maybe she'd like him more if he learned how to make balloon animals?

english: I bet he'd sell them for way more than my allowance, though...
french: Même s'il les vendrait sûrement plus cher que ce que j'ai en argent de poche...
russian: Хотя наверняка у него они бы стоили больше, чем мне дают карманных...
bulgarian: I bet he'd sell them for way more than my allowance, though...

english: Maple doesn't trust Mister Wheedle, but I don't know, he kind of reminds me of a clown!
french: Maple se méfie de monsieur Wheedle. Moi, il me fait penser à un clown !
russian: Мэйпл не доверяет мистеру Хлюсту. Не знаю, по-моему, он напоминает клоуна!
bulgarian: Maple doesn't trust Mister Wheedle, but I don't know, he kind of reminds me of a clown!

english: He didn't seem very happy when I told him that, though...
french: Il a fait une drôle de tête quand je lui ai fait remarquer...
russian: Правда, ему не понравилось, когда я ему это сказал...
bulgarian: He didn't seem very happy when I told him that, though...

english: Mister Wheedle's always rubbing his hands together like a little praying mantis, or maybe a fly.
french: Monsieur Wheedle se frotte toujours les mains, on dirait une mante religieuse ou une mouche.
russian: Мистер Хлюст всегда потирает руки, словно маленький богомол или какая-нибудь мушка.
bulgarian: Mister Wheedle's always rubbing his hands together like a little praying mantis, or maybe a fly.

english: They met back when my Dad was in a band!
french: Ils se sont connus quand mon papa jouait dans un groupe !
russian: Они познакомились, когда отец играл в группе!
bulgarian: They met back when my Dad was in a band!

english: Did you know Zorel is friends with my Mom and Dad?
french: Tu savais que Zorel était copine avec mon papa et ma maman ?
russian: Ты знаешь, что Зорель дружит с моими родителями?
bulgarian: Did you know Zorel is friends with my Mom and Dad?

english: I see so many similarities to the insects of today!
french: Il ressemble tellement aux insectes actuels !
russian: Я вижу много общего с нынешними насекомыми!
bulgarian: I see so many similarities to the insects of today!

english: The =Amber Trapped Insect= in the Museum's collection is fascinating, [Ari].
french: Je trouve l'=insecte piégé dans l'ambre= de la collection du musée proprement fascinant, [Ari].
russian: То =Насекомое в янтаре= в музейной коллекции — это так интересно, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The =Amber Trapped Insect= in the Museum's collection is fascinating, [Ari].

english: Bee fact! People think they're called bumble bees because they're bumbling, but that's not true at all! It's because their genus is Bombus!
french: Petite anecdote ! On croit souvent que les bourdons s'appellent comme ça à cause du bruit qu'ils font, mais c'est faux ! C'est parce qu'ils sont du genre Bombus.
russian: Время фактов о пчёлах! Шмели и пчёлы — близкие родственники. И шмели тоже умеют делать мёд.
bulgarian: Bee fact! People think they're called bumble bees because they're bumbling, but that's not true at all! It's because their genus is Bombus!

english: Bombus means to buzz! So they're more like buzzing bees! Buzzz~!
french: Bombus, ça veut dire vrombir ! Alors ce sont un peu comme des abeilles vrombissantes. Bzzz !
russian: Но он не такой вкусный и плохо хранится, поэтому его никто не использует!
bulgarian: Bombus means to buzz! So they're more like buzzing bees! Buzzz~!

english: I saw the =Bumble Bee= at the Museum! They're so round and fluffy!
french: J'ai vu le =bourdon=, au musée. Il est rond et duveteux !
russian: Я видел в музее =шмеля=! Они такие толстенькие и пушистые!
bulgarian: I saw the =Bumble Bee= at the Museum! They're so round and fluffy!

english: Mister Errol said you caught the =Cave Shrimp= at the Museum! Did you know that shrimps aren't insects? They're crustaceans! But I think they're cute anyway.
french: Monsieur Errol a dit que c'était toi qui avais attrapé la =crevette troglodyte= exposée au musée ! Tu sais que ce n'est pas un insecte, mais un crustacé ? Enfin, je le trouve adorable quand même.
russian:
Мистер Эррол сказал, что это ты

поймали

поймалапоймалпоймало =пещерную креветку=, которая в музее! Знаешь, креветки не насекомые! Это ракообразные! Но они мне всё равно нравятся.
bulgarian: Mister Errol said you caught the =Cave Shrimp= at the Museum! Did you know that shrimps aren't insects? They're crustaceans! But I think they're cute anyway.

english: It's true... they do look like copper nuggets!
french: C'est vrai qu'il ressemble vraiment à du minerai de cuivre !
russian: Это правда... они правда похожи на медные самородки!
bulgarian: It's true... they do look like copper nuggets!

english: I was so excited when I saw the =Copper Nugget Beetle= at the Museum, [Ari]! I'm not allowed in the Mines, so it was my first time seeing one!
french: J'ai failli m'évanouir en voyant le =scarabée cuprifère= au musée, [Ari] ! Je n'ai pas le droit d'aller dans les mines, alors c'était la première fois que j'en avais un sous les yeux !
russian: Я так обрадовался, когда увидел =медного жука-самородка= в музее, [Ari]! Меня в шахты не пускают, так что я увидел его впервые!
bulgarian: I was so excited when I saw the =Copper Nugget Beetle= at the Museum, [Ari]! I'm not allowed in the Mines, so it was my first time seeing one!

english: Predators think that's gross, so they leave them alone! That wouldn't work on Dell, though.
french: Les prédateurs trouvent ça dégoûtant, alors ils la laissent tranquille ! Bon, ce n'est pas ça qui découragerait Dell...
russian: Хищникам это противно, и они отстают! Но на Делл бы не подействовало.
bulgarian: Predators think that's gross, so they leave them alone! That wouldn't work on Dell, though.

english: It's lucky that Dell is a friend to all caterpillars.
french: Elle adore toutes les chenilles.
russian: Хорошо, что Делл дружит со всеми гусеницами.
bulgarian: It's lucky that Dell is a friend to all caterpillars.

english: The shiny parts of a $Crystal Caterpillar$ are actually a defense mechanism! They're super sticky and break off easily.
french: Les éléments brillants d'une $chenille de cristal$ sont en fait des défenses ! Ils se collent partout et se brisent facilement.
russian: Блестящие части у $кристальной гусеницы$ — это защитный механизм! Они суперлипкие и легко отваливаются.
bulgarian: The shiny parts of a $Crystal Caterpillar$ are actually a defense mechanism! They're super sticky and break off easily.

english: Juniper told me an old story about bad fairies cursed to be bees... but wouldn't it be the other way around?
french: Juniper m'a raconté l'histoire de ces vilaines fées qui auraient été transformées en abeilles... mais ce n'est pas une punition, ça !
russian: Джунипер рассказала мне старую историю, что плохие феи были прокляты и стали пчёлками... но разве не наоборот?
bulgarian: Juniper told me an old story about bad fairies cursed to be bees... but wouldn't it be the other way around?

english: I would LOVE to be a bee, personally.
french: Moi, j'adorerais être une abeille...
russian: Если честно, я и сам МЕЧТАЛ БЫ стать пчёлой.
bulgarian: I would LOVE to be a bee, personally.

english: [Ari], I could NOT believe my eyes when I was at the Museum. A =Fairy Bee=! It's like a dream!
french: [Ari], je n'en ai pas cru mes yeux quand j'ai vu cette =abeille féérique= au musée ! C'était comme un rêve !
russian: [Ari], я ПРОСТО не поверил глазам, когда был в музее. =Фея-пчёлка=! Это похоже на сон!
bulgarian: [Ari], I could NOT believe my eyes when I was at the Museum. A =Fairy Bee=! It's like a dream!

english: It has a really unique habitat, so I guess it would be hard to keep as a pet.
french: Son habitat est si unique que ça doit être difficile d'en avoir une chez soi.
russian: Правда, у неё крайне необычная среда обитания, так что держать дома вряд ли получится.
bulgarian: It has a really unique habitat, so I guess it would be hard to keep as a pet.

english: I'll just have to keep visiting the one at the Museum!
french: Je continuerai donc à aller voir celle du musée !
russian: Значит, придётся почаще навещать её в музее!
bulgarian: I'll just have to keep visiting the one at the Museum!

english: The $Fire Wasp$ is such a fascinating creature.
french: La $guêpe incandescente$ est une créature vraiment fascinante.
russian: $Огненная оса$ — такое потрясающее создание.
bulgarian: The $Fire Wasp$ is such a fascinating creature.

english: Bee fact! You might think that bees are always yellow and black, but that's not true at all!
french: Petite anecdote ! On pourrait croire que les abeilles sont toujours jaunes et noires, mais ce n'est pas vrai.
russian: Пчелиный факт! Может показаться, что все пчёлы жёлто-чёрные, но это не так!
bulgarian: Bee fact! You might think that bees are always yellow and black, but that's not true at all!

english: Bees come in every color of the rainbow!
french: Les abeilles sont de toutes les couleurs possibles et imaginables !
russian: Пчёлы бывают всех цветов радуги!
bulgarian: Bees come in every color of the rainbow!

english: It's so cool to see a $Flower Bee$ at the Museum!
french: C'est trop bien d'avoir une $abeille fleurie$ au musée !
russian: Я так обрадовался, когда увидел в музее $цветочную пчелу$!
bulgarian: It's so cool to see a $Flower Bee$ at the Museum!

english: I'm not sure why these beetles adorn themselves with little flowers. Camouflage, maybe?
french: Je me demande pourquoi ils se recouvrent de petites fleurs comme ça... Pour se camoufler ?
russian: Я не совсем понял, зачем эти жуки украшаются цветочками. Маскировка, может?
bulgarian: I'm not sure why these beetles adorn themselves with little flowers. Camouflage, maybe?

english: Miss Celine called it cute! Not a very scientific observation, but it is true.
french: Mademoiselle Céline a dit qu'il était mignon ! Ce n'est pas très scientifique comme observation, mais elle a raison.
russian: Мисс Селин сказала, что он милый! Не очень научное заключение, но всё равно правда.
bulgarian: Miss Celine called it cute! Not a very scientific observation, but it is true.

english: Miss Celine was so excited to see the $Flower Crown Beetle$ at the Museum.
french: Mademoiselle Céline était trop contente de voir un $scarabée fleuri$ au musée.
russian: Мисс Селин так обрадовалась, увидев $жука-цветоноса$ в музее.
bulgarian: Miss Celine was so excited to see the $Flower Crown Beetle$ at the Museum.

english: I think they're the perfect ambassadors for all bee-kind! They're so cute and furry...
french: Ce sont les meilleures ambassadrices du monde des abeilles ! Elles sont tellement mignonnes, avec tous ces poils...
russian: Мне кажется, это самые привлекательные представители всего пчелиного народа! Такие миленькие и пушистые...
bulgarian: I think they're the perfect ambassadors for all bee-kind! They're so cute and furry...

english: They're sure to make everyone a bee fan!
french: Grâce à elles, tout le monde va se mettre à adorer les abeilles.
russian: Кто угодно полюбит пчёл, когда их увидит!
bulgarian: They're sure to make everyone a bee fan!

english: There's now a $Fur Bee$ at the Museum. Please tell everyone to go visit it, [Ari]!
french: Il y a une $abeille touffue$, maintenant, au musée. S'il te plaît, dis à tout le monde d'aller la voir, [Ari] !
russian: В музее появилась $мохнатая пчела$! Пожалуйста, расскажи всем, чтобы они посмотрели, [Ari]!
bulgarian: There's now a $Fur Bee$ at the Museum. Please tell everyone to go visit it, [Ari]!

english: The $Gem Shard Caterpillar$ at the Museum looks so unusual! I wonder what it looks like after it undergoes metamorphosis.
french: La $chenille lapidaire$ du musée a vraiment une drôle d'allure ! Je me demande à quoi elle ressemblera après sa métamorphose.
russian: Музейная $самоцветная гусеница$ выглядит очень необычно! Интересно, как она будет выглядеть после метаморфозы?
bulgarian: The $Gem Shard Caterpillar$ at the Museum looks so unusual! I wonder what it looks like after it undergoes metamorphosis.

english: It just goes to show, there's an insect out there for everyone.
french: Ça prouve qu'il y a des insectes pour tous les goûts.
russian: Вот видишь: для каждого человека есть своё насекомое.
bulgarian: It just goes to show, there's an insect out there for everyone.

english: Mister Balor didn't like insects much, until I showed him the $Jewel Beetle$ at the Museum!
french: Monsieur Balor n'était pas très fan des insectes, jusqu'à ce que je lui montre le $scarabée moiré$ du musée !
russian: Мистеру Балору не нравились насекомые, пока я не показал ему $златку$ в музее!
bulgarian: Mister Balor didn't like insects much, until I showed him the $Jewel Beetle$ at the Museum!

english: It uses the energy it stored up when it was a caterpillar!
french: Elle utilise l'énergie qu'elle a stockée quand elle était chenille !
russian: Она использует энергию, накопленную, когда была гусеницей!
bulgarian: It uses the energy it stored up when it was a caterpillar!

english: The $Luna Moth$ at the Museum is so green! Did you know that the Luna Moth doesn't actually eat?
french: La $phalène lunaire$ du musée est d'un vert éclatant ! Au fait, tu savais qu'elle ne mange pas ?
russian: Музейная $сатурния луна$ такая зелёная! Ты знаешь, что она вообще не ест?
bulgarian: The $Luna Moth$ at the Museum is so green! Did you know that the Luna Moth doesn't actually eat?

english: Bee fact! Most bees are only awake during the day, but $Moonlight Bees$ are nocturnal!
french: Petite anecdote ! La plupart d'entre elles vivent le jour, mais les $abeilles du clair de lune$ sont nocturnes !
russian: Пчелиный факт! Большинство пчёл активны днём, но $лунные пчёлы$ — ночные насекомые!
bulgarian: Bee fact! Most bees are only awake during the day, but $Moonlight Bees$ are nocturnal!

english: That's why their eyes are even larger than normal! All five of them!
french: C'est pour ça que leurs yeux sont plus grands que la normale. Leurs cinq yeux !
russian: Поэтому глаза у них ещё больше, чем у остальных! Все пять штук!
bulgarian: That's why their eyes are even larger than normal! All five of them!

english: Amazing, [Ari], you found a $Moonlight Bee$! They're very special.
french: Incroyable, [Ari]. Tu as trouvé une $abeille du clair de lune$ ! Elles sont très particulières.
russian:
Невероятно, [Ari], ты

нашли

нашланашёлнашло $лунную пчелу$! Они сильно отличаются от остальных.
bulgarian: Amazing, [Ari], you found a $Moonlight Bee$! They're very special.

english: According to my insect handbook, they watch for ripples on the surface of a puddle. A very unique way of catching prey!
french: D'après mon manuel des insectes, elle se met l'affût des ondulations à la surface de l'eau. C'est une drôle de manière de traquer ses proies !
russian: Судя по моей энтомологической книге, он следит за рябью на воде. Очень необычный способ ловли добычи!
bulgarian: According to my insect handbook, they watch for ripples on the surface of a puddle. A very unique way of catching prey!

english: The =Puddle Spider= at the Museum is a wonderful specimen, [Ari]. Did you get to see it hunt?
french: L'=araignée d'eau= du musée est un spécimen incroyable, [Ari]. Est-ce que tu en as déjà vu une chasser ?
russian:
Тот =лужескок= в музее — потрясающий экземпляр, [Ari]! Ты

видели

виделавиделвидело, как он охотится?
bulgarian: The =Puddle Spider= at the Museum is a wonderful specimen, [Ari]. Did you get to see it hunt?

english: Well, I'm impressed.
french: En tout cas, ça a marché sur moi.
russian: Ну, меня впечатлил.
bulgarian: Well, I'm impressed.

english: Wow, I've never seen a =Sea Scarab= before the one at the Museum! I wonder why its carapace is that pretty blue color? Is it trying to impress someone?
french: Waouh, je n'avais jamais vu de =scarabée marin= avant celui du musée ! Je me demande pourquoi sa carapace est d'un bleu si joli... C'est pour impressionner quelqu'un ?
russian: Ух ты, я никогда не видел =водяного скарабея=, пока он не появился в музее! Интересно, почему у него такой красивый синий панцирь? Может, он хочет кого-то впечатлить?
bulgarian: Wow, I've never seen a =Sea Scarab= before the one at the Museum! I wonder why its carapace is that pretty blue color? Is it trying to impress someone?

english: That's the power of nature. Dell could take some notes, her snowballs are always lopsided.
french: C'est ça, le pouvoir de la nature. Dell devrait en prendre de la graine, parce que ses boules de neige ne sont jamais régulières.
russian: Вот она, сила природы! Делл стоило бы поучиться: у неё снежки всегда кривые.
bulgarian: That's the power of nature. Dell could take some notes, her snowballs are always lopsided.

english: I saw the =Snowball Beetle= you donated to the Museum, [Ari]! Wow! How does it make such perfectly round snowballs?
french: J'ai vu le =scarabée des neiges= dont tu as fait don au musée, [Ari] ! Comment il arrive à former des boules de neige aussi parfaites ?
russian:
Я видел =жука-снежка=, которого ты

пожертвовали

пожертвовалапожертвовалпожертвовало музею, [Ari]! Вау! Как он делает такие идеально круглые снежки?
bulgarian: I saw the =Snowball Beetle= you donated to the Museum, [Ari]! Wow! How does it make such perfectly round snowballs?

english: Do you suppose the red shell makes it go faster?
french: Tu crois qu'il va plus vite à cause de sa coquille rouge ?
russian: Как думаешь, они такие быстрые, потому что у них раковина красная?
bulgarian: Do you suppose the red shell makes it go faster?

english: Up to now, it's always been hard to study the $Speedy Snail$. It's super rare, and it always runs away super fast!
french: Étudier l'$escargot véloce$ s'est avéré difficile jusqu'ici. Il est super rare et il file à toute vitesse !
russian: До сих пор изучать $скоростных улиток$ было очень сложно. Они суперредкие и вечно удирают!
bulgarian: Up to now, it's always been hard to study the $Speedy Snail$. It's super rare, and it always runs away super fast!

english: The range of colors it can glow! Fascinating!
french: C'est incroyable toutes les couleurs qu'elle peut émettre !
russian: Она может излучать столько разных цветов! Удивительно!
bulgarian: The range of colors it can glow! Fascinating!

english: Is it for hunting? Warding off predators? A mating ritual? This requires further research...
french: C'est pour chasser, repousser les prédateurs ou trouver un partenaire ? Il faudrait étudier ça de plus près...
russian: Для охоты? Чтобы отпугивать хищников? Или это брачный ритуал? Это надо изучить...
bulgarian: Is it for hunting? Warding off predators? A mating ritual? This requires further research...

english: You caught a =Strobe Firefly=, [Ari]! I saw it at the Museum!
french: Tu as attrapé une =luciole étincelante=, [Ari]. Je l'ai vue au musée !
russian:
Ты

поймали

поймалапоймалпоймало =мерцающего светлячка=, [Ari]! Я видел её в музее!
bulgarian: You caught a =Strobe Firefly=, [Ari]! I saw it at the Museum!

english: Bee fact! Most bees are really pale when they're born, and their colors get brighter after they're a day old...
french: Petite anecdote ! À leur naissance, la plupart sont très pâles et leurs couleurs deviennent plus vives dès leur deuxième jour...
russian: Пчелиный факт! Большинство пчёл рождаются бледными и приобретают свой окрас примерно через день после рождения...
bulgarian: Bee fact! Most bees are really pale when they're born, and their colors get brighter after they're a day old...

english: But $Sweet Bees$ are always pale. It's like they're cute babies forever!
french: Mais les $abeilles gracieuses$ restent toujours pâles. Comme si elles étaient pour toujours de jolis bébés !
russian: А $милые пчёлы$ остаются бледными. Поэтому они как будто вечно милые малышки!
bulgarian: But $Sweet Bees$ are always pale. It's like they're cute babies forever!

english: The Museum's $Sweet Bee$ is such a pretty color!
french: L'$abeille gracieuse$ du musée est d'une si jolie couleur !
russian: У $милой пчелы$ в музее такой красивый цвет!
bulgarian: The Museum's $Sweet Bee$ is such a pretty color!

english: Wouldn't it be fun to have a tiny dinosaur in REAL LIFE?
french: Ce serait génial d'avoir un dinosaure miniature en vrai, non ?
russian: Разве не было бы круто завести крошечного динозавра В РЕАЛЬНОЙ ЖИЗНИ?
bulgarian: Wouldn't it be fun to have a tiny dinosaur in REAL LIFE?

english: Errol showed me the $Tiny Dinosaur Skeleton$ in the Pre-History collection! It's really neat!
french: Errol m'a montré le $squelette de dinosaure miniature$ dans les salles consacrées à la préhistoire ! Il est magnifique !
russian: Эррол показал мне $крошечный скелет динозавра$ в зале Протоистории! Он такой классный!
bulgarian: Errol showed me the $Tiny Dinosaur Skeleton$ in the Pre-History collection! It's really neat!

english: That's called an adaptation!
french: C'est ce qu'on appelle l'adaptation.
russian: Это называется «адаптация»!
bulgarian: That's called an adaptation!

english: Did you know? The $Windleaf Butterfly$ at the Museum looks like dry leaves to hide itself from predators.
french: Tu savais que le $papillon des feuillages$ du musée ressemble à des feuilles pour se protéger des prédateurs ?!
russian: Хочешь занимательный факт? $Бабочка-листвянка$ в музее маскируется под сухую листву, чтобы прятаться от хищников.
bulgarian: Did you know? The $Windleaf Butterfly$ at the Museum looks like dry leaves to hide itself from predators.
